title: fix(image): reject non-1024 dimensions for lightning-image-turbo
author: Saauf

gist.summary: Requests to inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo that explicitly specify dimensions other than 1024×1024 now receive a 400 error instead of silently returning a 1024×1024 image. Validation rejects those requests before contacting the billable upstream provider. Requests without dimensions still use the 1024×1024 default, and regression tests cover the behavior.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli checks a 1024×1024 picture frame beside a small retro terminal, while an incorrectly sized frame rests off to the side among pixel flowers; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently against a warm cream and pastel gradient background. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, wears tiny inspector glasses, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
